red_proof: All commands used Git Bash and .venv/Scripts/python.exe -X utf8 -B -m pytest -q tests/test_review_regressions.py before the corresponding implementation fix. Initial run: exit 1, 11 failed, 1 passed; test_reaccepting_missing_evidence_stays_stale expected stale_review but got accepted; test_source_stances_are_relative_to_negative_claim got s3=supports/s4=conflicts instead of conflicts/supports; test_export_does_not_replay_a_different_documents_ledger leaked accepted state/content in Markdown, JSON and DOCX; test_failed_save_does_not_publish_review_or_edit retained an unsaved ledger record or edited text after HTTP 500. summary: Fixed eight findings with 23 new regression cases: unavailable evidence stays stale even after re-acceptance, source stances compare against the claim, edits and approvals publish only after persistence, in-flight replacements are rejected, exports verify the ledger document, and every format/CLI receipt uses the accepted subset for both content and metrics. DOCX now labels review mode/state, and queue navigation covers edited acceptance and hidden pending targets; existing tests and quality thresholds were preserved. The full configured suite passed with 946 passed, 1 existing fixture-dependent skip and 12 integration tests deselected; the CI deselection gate passed with all 38 substitute tests selected.
